Organization''' ('''Threat Defense Strategy Organization'''[[File:TheFinalActPI7.png|280px]]Name seen on the screens of [[The Final Act Event]]'s opening cutscene.), is the protagonist force of the Tower Defense Simulator storyline. Their duty is to fight against the zombies, monsters and other enemies who so wish to pose a challenge to the security of the [[Overworld]] and other realms. The history and founding of the organization is unknown, along with its founders and the primary cause for its creation. During the span of the organization's existence, its members have fought a variety of foes, ranging from [[Brute|the]] [[Grave Digger|five]] [[Patient Zero|survival]] [[Molten Warlord|mode]] [[Fallen King|bosses]], to many of the [[Events|event bosses]]. A handful of these opponents have been fought against multiple times, such as [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]], the [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky]] [[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|D00Ms]], and according to in-game dialogues and trailers, the [[Molten Warlord]], and the [[Fallen King]]. ==Notable Members== In gameplay, and in trailers, we are shown various members of the organization, varying from regular soldiers to scientists. Out of these, there are at least twelve notable members of the organization. There exists a type of command hierarchy within the organization's members as alluded to by gameplay and extra content. The [[Dispatcher]], [[Commander]] and the player, known as the Recruit, are the only high-ranking members known. It is suggested that there are higher positions above the [[Commander]] and the [[Dispatcher]] in the '''T.D.S. Organization''', as the [[Commander]] was required to get authorization before confronting the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] in [[The Final Act Event]].[[File:Hqauthorization.png|thumb|250x250px]] Other agents are suggested to be ranked lower than them; all towers are assumed to be agents of the '''T.D.S. Organization.''' Other agents working for the '''T.D.S. Organization''' exist, which is shown through dialogue, null enemies and [[Logbooks]], but they are not shown on-screen within canon material. These likely include every tower in the game which is not seen during cutscenes or trailers, but can be seen in the actual gameplay. {{Clear}} ===Dispatcher=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Dispatcher |image = Dispatchernullandvoid.jpg |position = Dispatch Officer |real_name = Jane |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/959606619/profile AerelisVA] }} The [[Dispatcher]] is the dispatch officer for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. She helps supply on-duty agents with crucial information about their current foe, and is responsible for the field deployment of agents. The winged pin she wears on her vest that sports the '''T.D.S. Organization's''' logo suggests that she is a fairly high-ranking member within the agency. The broader significance and purpose of this rank is unknown. The in-game dialogue for [[Outpost 16]] says that the [[Dispatcher]] used to work in the field{{InlineQuote|You know, I kind of miss being out in the field. Reminds me of our earlier years.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 9 ([[Outpost 16]])}}, either as a field commander or an agent. The [[Dispatcher]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. {{Clear}} ===Commander=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Commander |image = Commanderfailedgateway.jpg |position = Field Commander |voice_actor = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] }} The [[Commander]] is the field commander for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. His job is to lead and command on-duty agents on the battlefield. The winged crest on his cap suggests that the [[Commander]] is one of the few high-ranking individuals within the organization, as with the likes of the [[Dispatcher]]. The [[Commander]] primarily appeared in his default Level 2 variant. As of [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode, the [[Commander]] is now represented by his Level 4 variant. According to the [[Null Missile APC]] [[Logbooks|Logbook]], the [[Missile APC]] was the first vehicle [[Commander]] had ever commanded after his first promotion.{{InlineQuote|Seeing the APC brought back memories of his first promotion, as it was the first vehicle he ever commanded.|[[Null Missile APC]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} The [[Commander]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. {{Clear}} ===Recruit=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Recruit |image = PlayerStoryMode.png |position = Commissioned Officer }} The Recruit is a character within the story of Tower Defense Simulator that exists to be the stand-in for the player. There is no uniform appearance for the Recruit, as in cutscenes, they are always represented by the current avatar the player is wearing. The Recruit's job ranges from strategizing troop movements to setting up defenses on the front line. The Recruit was hired during Chapter 0 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode by the '''T.D.S. Organization''' through a new program that seeks to expand their division by bringing in new leaders and strategists.{{InlineQuote|It's part of a new program to help expand our division. We need more leaders to help us strategize and control the outbreak. Maybe one day we'll finally be able to wipe out the zombies.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 6 ([[Radio Silence]])}}{{Clear}} ===Scout=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Scout |image = Scoutoutpost32.jpg |position = Field Agent }} The [[Scout]] is one of the agents who work for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. It is unknown if his label has any correlation to his role on the battlefield, however, his weaponry suggests that he is a sort of light infantry. The [[Scout]] appears within the story primarily as his default Level 4 variant. The [[Scout]] was hired by the '''T.D.S. Organization''' some time after the events of Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode after he was rejected from every other known defensive agency.[[Aftermath]] As of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]], the [[Scout]] is possibly of a higher position than other agents in the organization, as he was shown leading the [[Soldier]] and the [[Pyromancer]] on a mission into the [[Duck Realm]]. {{Clear}} ===Sniper=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Sniper |image = SniperStoryMode.png |position = Field Agent |voice_actor = [https://x.com/trashdotmanva Owen McNicholl] }} The [[Sniper]] is another of the agents who work for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. His role on the battlefield is directly related to his title, as his job is to posted up on vantage points to pick off high value targets to support his group. The [[Sniper]] appears within the story as his default Level 2 variant. The [[Sniper]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. {{Clear}} ===Demoman=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Demoman |image = DemomanStoryMode.png |position = Field Agent |voice_actor = [https://x.com/SSleiya Ryshawn Fletcher] }} The [[Demoman]] is another agent who works for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. His role on the battlefield relates to his title, [[Demoman]] is demolition specialist, responsible for using explosives to clear out hordes of zombies, along with using explosives to demolish obstacles. The [[Demoman]] appears within the story as his default Level 1 variant. The [[Demoman]] has once disobeyed commanding orders from the '''T.D.S. Organization''' by responding to a distress signal from survivors with [[Hops]] in Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. The [[Demoman]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. {{Clear}} ===Soldier=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Soldier |image = SoldierStoryMode.png |position = Field Agent |voice_actor = [https://x.com/JonDavidTalent Jonathan David Bullock] }} The [[Soldier]] is another one of the agents who work for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. The [[Soldier]]'s role on the battlefield is to directly neutralize enemy targets with his rifle, along with providing covering fire for less mobile troops, such as the [[Minigunner]]. The [[Soldier]] appears within the story as his default Level 2 variant. The [[Soldier]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. Before he joined the organization, the [[Soldier]] was previously enlisted in the military. {{Clear}} ===Trapper=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Trapper |image = TrapperStoryMode.png |position = Miner |voice_actor = [https://x.com/CamscamIsHere Cameron Crawford] }} The [[Trapper]] is not exactly a common agent unlike the others, as he was actually kicked out of training.{{InlineQuote|Why are you down here anyway? The last time I saw you — you were arguing with the recruitment officer about being kicked out of training.|[[Sniper (Narrator)|Sniper]] on Wave 7 ([[Rock Bottom]])}} However, the '''T.D.S. Organization''' let him stay within its ranks as an overseer of [[Crystal Cave]] to make sure its operations are not meddled with.{{InlineQuote|Because he was blaming me for letting one of the guys step in a bear trap! Sure, it might've been me, but not that they could prove it. Turns out I have a gift and the city needs crystals. So I stay in that little hut over there for a few days and make sure things are safe. For the most part.|[[Trapper (Narrator)|Trapper]] on Wave 7 ([[Rock Bottom]])}} He does this with the help of his traps that he sets up around the cave which activate whenever a zombie steps on it. As of [[The Final Act Event]], the [[Trapper]] seems to be more active within the immediate ranks of the T.D.S Organization, as he was seen inside T.D.S. HQ with other agents in the opening cutscene to [[The Narratorium]]. The [[Trapper]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. {{Clear}} ===Minigunner=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Minigunner |image = Minigunnercontainment.jpg |position = Field Agent }} The [[Minigunner]] is another one of the agents who work for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. His label is representative of role on the battlefield—wielding a minigun to mow down hordes of enemies. He is shown in his default Level 1 variant. The [[Minigunner]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. {{Clear}} ===Engineer=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Engineer |image = EngineerStory.png |position = Engineer |relatives = [[Brawler]] (Brother{{InlineQuote|Brawler would have a field day fighting these things. I don't think anyone has faster reflexes than him.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 23 ([[Blind Faith]])}}
{{InlineQuote|I don't know about that. I heard from his sister that Assassin and Slasher are always training with him.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 23 ([[Blind Faith]])}}) |voice_actor = [https://x.com/skylarxene Sky Santacruz] }} The [[Engineer]] is another one of the agents who work for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. She is an engineer that works and creates various vehicles and mechanical items for the organization and rarely leaves the '''T.D.S. Organization''' bases.{{InlineQuote|Wait, me? But you know I don't leave the base.|[[Engineer]] in the opening cutscene for [[The Narratorium]]}} She is usually depicted with her default Level 1 appearance. Some of the [[Engineer]]'s creations include the [[Pursuit]],{{InlineQuote|The [[Null Pursuit]] flew in, leaving [[Engineer]] in awe as it was piloted by two skeletal figures within. She spent ages perfecting that rotorcraft, and the [[Old World|Nil Zone]] copied every last detail down to the missiles it fired at her team|[[Null Pursuit]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} the sentries{{InlineQuote|The Null Sentry was created using the schematics stolen from Engineer.|[[Null Sentry]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} and the [[Brawler]]'s fists.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yJSHAVeWsTg More things are implied to be made by or at least maintained by her, like the [[Turret]] and [[Missile APC]] which are shown in the building she made [[Brawler]]'s fists in. The [[Engineer]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode.{{Clear}} ===Hops=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Hops |image = HopsStoryMode.png |position = Field Agent |voice_actor = [https://x.com/VoicesByCorey Corey LeVier] }} [[Hops]] is another agents who works for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. Unlike other field agents, [[Hops]] is not actually a tower that can be played with in-game. Based off his weaponry in Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode, [[Hops]]' role on the battlefield seems to be similar to that of [[Sniper]]'s or [[Hunter]]'s, using a rifle to neutralize enemies from a long range. Alongside the [[Demoman]], [[Hops]] was one of the agents who disobeyed direct orders and went to go help the [[Abandoned City]] survivors in Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. [[Hops]] has worked in the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. Before he joined the organization, [[Hops]] was previously enlisted in the military. It is unknown whether the badge on [[Hops]]' beret represents his place within the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. {{Clear}} ===Professor V=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Professor V |image = Professorvoutpost32.jpg |position = Researcher |voice_actor = [https://x.com/emvaofficial EmVA] }} [[Professor V]] is one of the researchers that work for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. Her work has benefitted the agency in several ways, such as her technology that allows field agents to see that kind of modifiers certain enemies possess.{{InlineQuote|[[Professor V]] has given us the technology that lets us see their stats and modifiers if you select them.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 6 ([[Easy Mode|Easy]])}} But most notably, her work on interdimensional travel using [[God Cube]] shards that she was enlisted for in the aftermath of the [[Hexscape Event]].{{InlineQuote|🧊In the wake of the Hexscape incident, our brightest mind, [[Professor V]], has been leading classified research into the enigmatic science of cross-world travel. [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], our most advanced facility, has been repurposed for these critical experiments.|[[v1.46.0]] Update Log}} [[Professor V]] pioneered the "''[[Tower Evolution|Evolution]] Project''," starting to work on it around the time [[The Final Act Event]] took place{{InlineQuote|I've been telling [[Professor V|V]] the same thing since she's been burning herself out on this new; "Evolution Project".|[[Engineer]] in the opening cutscene for [[The Narratorium]]}} as a response to [[Lord Exo]]'s freedom. It can be assumed a proper evolved unit joined the '''T.D.S. Organization''' around the time [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode takes place.[[File:EvolvedTowerProof.png|280px]]
https://x.com/paradoxum_games/status/2060456205898940472 The in-game dialogue for the [[Null & Void Event]] says that [[Professor V]] has been making technology in [[Cyber City]] for years.{{InlineQuote|[[Professor V|V]] has been creating technology in [[Cyber City]] for years, so I trust her to figure something out.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 3 ([[Banlands]])}} Though, it is unknown whether this was done under the supervision of the '''T.D.S. Organization''', or by her own agenda. [[Professor V]] has worked with the '''T.D.S. Organization''' since before Chapter 1 of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. {{Clear}} ==Bases== The different bases that the '''T.D.S. Organization''' operates within are spread out in diverse locations. Each base is different than the other, serving distinct purposes. ===T.D.S. Headquarters=== {{LocationInfobox |title = T.D.S. HQ |image = |-|Debriefing Room = [[File:TDSHQ.jpg]] |-|Control Room = [[File:TDSHQcontrolroom.png]] |-|Mission Staging = [[File:TDSHQmissionstaging.png]] |purpose = Operations Facility }} T.D.S. Headquarters, also known as T.D.S. HQ, or just HQ, is the main base of operations for the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. From there is where the organization dispatches its field agents and debriefs them on the threats they face. Several parts of HQ have been shown in the various cutscenes throughout the game. The debriefing room is one of these places, there, the agents would be given information about the threat they are about to go up against. The [[Dispatcher]] also uses the debriefing room to watch over agents on the field. The control room is a location where the [[Commander]] reviewed information following the aftermath of Project God Merger and [[Lord Exo]]'s freedom, not much else is known about this place. Mission Staging is the location where the agents would suit up to get ready before being deployed out on to the field, multiple vehicles are also seen around the place due to the large bay doors that opened up to the outside world. {{Clear}} ===Outpost 32=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Outpost 32 |image = Outpost32.jpg |purpose = Portal Research Base }} [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] is the designated portal research base under the control of the '''T.D.S. Organization'''. From there, multiple researchers, such as [[Professor V]] and the Analyst, are tasked with understanding how the [[God Cube]] shards can be used for interdimensional travel. It has been stated that [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] is T.D.S.'s most advanced facility,{{InlineQuote|🧊In the wake of the Hexscape incident, our brightest mind, [[Professor V]], has been leading classified research into the enigmatic science of cross-world travel. [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], our most advanced facility, has been repurposed for these critical experiments.|[[v1.46.0]] Update Log}} which would explain why the personnel working there look to have more advanced equipment than the contemporary equipment that the field agents possess. The title of [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] suggests that there are at least 32 recognized outposts under T.D.S. jurisdiction. {{Clear}} ===Outpost 16=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Outpost 16 |image = Outpost16.jpg |purpose = Testing Facility }} [[Outpost 16]] is the testing facility that the '''T.D.S. Organization''' used to facilitate [[Professor V]] and the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]]'s Project God Merger, which aimed to merge all of the '''T.D.S. Organization's''' accumulated [[God Cube]] fragments into one unified whole. Though, after the project went awry, the facility incurred heavy damage, and is in the process of being repaired as of [[The Final Act Event]].[[File:Cybercityfacility.PNG|thumb|331x331px]] [[Outpost 16]] is located up in the mountains away from [[Cyber City]], for this reason, it is also known as the "''Cyber City Facility''" by T.D.S. {{Clear}} ===Unnamed Outpost=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Unnamed Outpost |image = PlaceC.png |purpose = Unknown }} There is another outpost under T.D.S. jurisdiction, albeit unnamed, mentioned in [[Molten Mode]] dialogue. This outpost is now defunct as it was completely destroyed in an unprecedented attack from the Molten, leaving no survivors.{{InlineQuote|The Molten are highly aggressive, so we need to be careful. The last rift they came from ended with an entire outpost being burned down. No one survived.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 1 ([[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} The unnamed outpost housed armories that contained advanced technology and weaponry that was stolen from T.D.S. by the Molten to use for their forces,{{InlineQuote|They must have stolen it from the outpost armories! Watch out for that Molten Mech!|[[Professor V]] on Wave 23 ([[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} that being the [[Molten Mech]], [[Molten Hound]], and possibly the [[Molten Golem]] if it to be assumed that the melted metal reinforcing them{{InlineQuote|Did they reinforce themselves with melted iron?!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 16 ([[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} came from the remnants of the outpost. {{Clear}} ==Allies== While not members of the '''T.D.S. Organization''', there are certain individuals who work with the agency on occasion to achieve common goals. ===Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus |image = |-|Santa Claus = [[File:PlaceC.png]] |-|Mrs. Claus = [[File:Mrsclauschristmastrailer.jpg]] }} [[Santa|Santa Claus]] and Mrs. Claus are two individuals that reside within the North Pole. [[Santa]]'s first known endeavors with the '''T.D.S. Organization''' is during the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. While the details are unclear, it is known for sure that the '''T.D.S. Organization''' dispatched agents to the North Pole to combat [[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]]'s invasion there. Whether Santa was present for the event is also unclear, but he at least has knowledge about this battle.{{InlineQuote|KRAMPUS?.. I thought you were defeated years ago!|[[Santa]] on Wave 20 ([[Krampus Frosthold]])}} In the [[Violent Night Event]], a mysterious force, later revealed to be [[Lord Exo]], mind controlled [[Santa]]'s elves, turning them against him to build weapons of mass destruction with their Christmas magic. Mrs. Claus was the one to inform the '''T.D.S. Organization''' about this, leading to them to once again embark to the North Pole to liberate [[Santa]]. The most recent case of the '''T.D.S. Organization''' and [[Santa|Santa Claus]] working together was in the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]], where [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] returns from his defeat to mind control [[Santa]]'s elves. [[Santa]] was luckily spared from whatever wrath he may have incurred, and served as an informant to the T.D.S. agents that were deployed to deal with the new threat. {{Clear}} ===Nerd Duck=== {{CharacterInfobox |name = [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] |image = NerdDuckNullVoid.png |position = Researcher }} The [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], as he is referred to, is the son of [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]], and is the de facto leader of the ducks. He was initially encountered by T.D.S. during the [[Duck Hunt Event]], as the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] came with his army seeking revenge on T.D.S. on behalf of [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|his deceased father]]{{InlineQuote|[[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]]'s son is out for revenge and sending an army of ducks to steal your crops!|[[v1.2.0]] in-game update log}}, whom they had killed. However, the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] was defeated, but had survived and escaped to the [[Duck Realm]]. During the [[Ducky Revenge Event]], T.D.S. agents were sent into the [[Duck Realm]] to search for a [[God Cube]] fragment they had detected, but they came across the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] and his people, who were harnessing the [[God Cube]] fragment for a [[Nerd Ducky|Mecha Bunny]]Name based on the [[Mecha Bunny + Nerd Ducky Mini Plush]] and the {{Color|Other|Mecha Bunny}} [[Cowboy]] skin, both of which use this name to describe the mech.. The agents defeat the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]], and [[Professor V]] comes into the [[Duck Realm]] to recruit the him into the '''T.D.S. Organization''' for his engineering prowess. In the [[Null & Void Event]], as the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] has been in the [[T.D.S. Organization]] for some time, he worked with [[Professor V]] on "''Project God Merger''" to merge the [[God Cube]] fragments they have collected into a partial cube, which ends up failing and causing the events of first [[Null & Void Event]] night. {{Clear}} ==Story== Events mentioned chronologically follow some sort of interconnection within the storyline, and can be cross-referenced with other events. The extent of this interconnection is unreliable, as some events cannot be verified to have accurate places on the timeline. Events mentioned non-chronologically can not be cross-referenced with other events to gauge a point on the timeline. Their ordering is arbitrary, and is not meant to be taken as one coming before the other, and vice versa. ===Chronological=== ==== TDS: Origins ==== The activities of the '''T.D.S. Organization''' in the past are revealed to us through this chapter. ===== Ghost Town ===== The [[Commander]] and his team of the [[Minigunner]], the [[Soldier]], the [[Sniper]], and the player travel to the [[Abandoned City]] to rescue any survivors there and bring them back to base but encounter a zombie horde there and are forced to clear it out. The team do not find the survivors, which prompts them to leave the city in search of another location. ===== Radio Silence ===== The [[Commander]]'s team travels to an army [[Forest Camp]] as that is where they believed the survivors could be hiding out after they left the [[Abandoned City]]. But still, they do not find the survivors. The zombie horde from the [[Abandoned City]] has been trailing the [[Commander]]'s team this entire time, following them to the [[Forest Camp]], which forces them to deal with them again while trying to find a new way out to find the survivors. ===== Off The Rails ===== The [[Commander]]'s team is led to [[U-Turn]] in search of the survivors, there, inside a convenience store, the [[Commander]] and the [[Soldier]] spot the [[Demoman]] and [[Hops]], two members of the '''T.D.S. Organization''' who had disobeyed orders and decided to help the survivors after receiving a distress signal from them. Together, the team comes up with a plan to successfully move the survivors out of the area and to [[Cyber City]]. ===== Burning Bridges ===== After taking advantage of a break in the zombie horde to escape through the railroad tracks to [[Cyber City]], the team is forced to stop because of the bridge that has been blown out. The zombie horde continues to follow the team, making them evaluate what options they have left to escape. The [[Demoman]] gets an idea to blow up the bridge behind them as they escape to stop the zombies from following them. The team agrees to this plan and gives the [[Demoman]] covering fire to help him prepare. Unfortunately, the bridge is blown up too fast for the agents to react, and [[Hops]] and the [[Demoman]] fall into the water with the rest of the zombies. ===== Derailed ===== After the rest of the agents escaped the zombies from the bridge, the day passes into night, and the group decides to catch their breath at a train station before moving onward. However, the explosion at the bridge would have alerted every zombie in the nearby area, so the agents are forced to hold back against any zombies that followed them to the train station before they continue onward. ===== Rock Bottom ===== The survivors, led by the agents, escape into [[Crystal Cave]] where they meet the [[Trapper]], who revealed to them that he set up a variety of traps within the cave to deter any zombies that attempt to waltz into the area. The [[Trapper]] mentions that he heard voices within the cave earlier that day, which prompts the attention of the [[Soldier]] to wonder if the voices belonged to [[Hops]] and [[Demoman]]. With the [[Trapper]]'s help, the [[Commander]] and his team navigate through the cave to [[Cyber City]]. ===== Surface Tension ===== The [[Trapper]] leads the Commander's group into the [[Cyber City]] crystal refinery. The [[Commander]] uses his radio to contact anyone from [[Cyber City]], to which [[Professor V]] responds. [[Professor V]] helps usher the team to the surface, but in doing so, some of the city's defenses had to be shut off. [[Hops]] and the [[Demoman]] appear to the group from within the refinery, but as they are not able to immediately rejoin the group, they are forced to find another way out on their own. ===== Lights Out ===== The [[Commander]]'s group manages to successfully reach [[Cyber City]], but as the defenses have been shut off for their arrival, the horde of zombies manages to reach up to them. They are forced to hold off until [[Professor V]] could restart the city's defenses. Just as the defenses reboot back online, the leader of the zombie horde reaches the group's location, and is revealed to be none other than the [[Grave Digger]]. The agents defeat the [[Grave Digger]], and in the aftermath, the [[Demoman]] rejoins the group without [[Hops]].
